request.source:
-- 只读检查停止现场、断点状态及目标参数；不继续游戏或修改断点。
local context=debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
local addresses={}
for _,address in ipairs(debug_getBreakpointList() or {}) do addresses[#addresses+1]=string.format('%X',address) end
local rows={}
local listOpen=false
for index=0,getFormCount()-1 do
    local form=getForm(index)
    if form.ClassName=='TfrmBreakpointlist' then
        listOpen=true
        local view=form.findComponentByName('ListView1')
        for row=0,view.Items.Count-1 do
            local item=view.Items[row]
            rows[#rows+1]={address=item.Caption,details=item.SubItems.Text}
        end
    end
end
local storage=readQword(0x3A484D9F8E8+8)
return {pid=getOpenedProcessID(),stopped=type(context)=='table',debugging=debug_isDebugging(),
    rip=type(context)=='table' and string.format('%X',context.RIP) or '',
    addresses=addresses,listOpen=listOpen,rows=rows,
    addInstruction=disassemble(getAddress('victoria3.exe+11FD93B')),
    removeInstruction=disassemble(getAddress('victoria3.exe+11FAF69')),
    goodsId=readInteger(0x3A4012E4A60+0x10),goodsName=readString(0x3A4012E4A60+0x18,5,false),
    capacity1D58=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8B8),capacity1D5C=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8BC),
    tableStorage=storage and string.format('%X',storage) or ''}
